summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable, so the worker marked orders processed without payments. Worker thread stalled (heartbeat 104s old) and the queue backed up to 460; the cause of the stall is not determined.
recommended: Confirm payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the migration.
Add an alert for payment provider failures that are logged only at DEBUG.
